Sunlight Sensitivity. DISADV on attacks in sunlight and 1d4 damage per round of exposure. VOID CREATURES These creatures are alien horrors from the dark reaches of space. While void bats are wild animals, void beings are sapient and malicious. They are ageless, not truly alive, and can travel vast distances in their black vessels. Void beings are conquerors and defilers. They quietly invade outer planets and wait patiently for the right moment to emerge and wreak havoc.
